title: proflow configuration
description: Configuration for the proflow harness mod: the dangerous-command guard and the footer. Read from ~/.commandcode/proflow.json(c) then .commandcode/proflow.json(c); built-in rules always apply and these layers add to (or waive) them.

$schema.description: JSON Schema reference for editor autocomplete and validation.

deny.description: Regular expressions for commands to hard-block before execution.

confirm.description: Regular expressions for commands that require confirmation.

allow.description: Regular expressions exempt from the deny and confirm tiers.

footer.description: Footer thresholds and colours. Every key is optional; the mod's defaults apply otherwise.

cache.description: Cache-hit rate thresholds: green at or above warnBelow, yellow at or above alertBelow, red below that.

context.description: Context-usage thresholds: green below warnAbove, yellow below alertAbove, red at or above it.

cost.description: Always applied to the turn cost. Default "blue".

colour.description: false prints the footer with no ANSI escapes at all. Default true.
